import * as C from "@constants";

These guided projects pair a realistic dataset with {C.COMPANY} product features so you learn by shipping a small vertical slice. Some run on a {C.CLOUD_LONG} service and visualize results in Grafana; others run on a local self-hosted {C.TIMESCALE_DB} instance with Docker and `psql`. Pick a domain close to your own stack and follow the steps in order.
